# t_funcs.ramp_onoff { #clerq.t_funcs.ramp_onoff }

```python
t_funcs.ramp_onoff(index)
```

Return a ramp-on / ramp-off time function.

The pulse rises smoothly, holds at ``ampl``, then falls smoothly. Built
by composing :func:`ramp_on` and :func:`ramp_off`.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                        | Default    |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------|------------|
| index  | int    | Integer suffix used to look up parameters in args. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                         |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | TFunc  | Callable ``f(t, args)`` reading ``ampl_{index}``, ``fwhm_{index}``, |
|        | TFunc  | ``on_{index}``, and ``off_{index}`` from args.                      |
